Made of quality glass with decorative film in a natural wood tone, it is a perfect choice for keeping spiders and insects. The vertical format gives enough room for climbing and natural behavior.

description.html: This is the smallest terrarium in our range: an 11x15 cm base, 20 cm of height and a volume of about 3.3 liters. It is made for invertebrates, for which a large space only makes finding food harder. The back is a 3D styrofoam background shaped like rock, which a spider or mantis climbs to the top.

The 20 cm height matters to mantises, which need free space below the spot they hang from in order to molt. For a smaller spider the same height gives room for a web in an upper corner. The vent is plastic and sits on the top. With a base the size of a palm, it fits on a shelf, a desk or in a display cabinet.

In this size you often ask for several pieces at once, for several animals, so we also make them in batches. The next size up in our range is the 17x20x28 with a 3D background. We build a different base or height by agreement, and we ship finished terrariums by courier. A custom build has a wait of 7 to 14 days, and even a model this small gets a film from our range of 34 patterns.
